intro: 12 個徵才與招聘情境高頻字。每個字附兩個例句、中譯,以及用法與衍生字提醒。

ex.en: The computer analyst was glad to have chosen a field in which jobs were abundant.
ex.zh: 這位電腦分析師很慶幸自己選了一個工作機會充足的領域。

ex.en: The recruiter was surprised by the abundant number of qualified applicants.
ex.zh: 招聘人員對符合資格的應徵者數量之多感到驚訝。

note: abundance 豐富、大量;abundantly 大量地

ex.en: The company was interested in hiring her because of her list of accomplishments.
ex.zh: 公司有意雇用她,是因為她有一長串的成就。

ex.en: Finding the right applicant for the job is a big accomplishment.
ex.zh: 為這個職位找到合適的應徵者是一大成就。

note: accomplish 完成、達成;accomplished 有造詣的

ex.en: Every year, the firm brings together its top lawyers and its newest recruits for a training session.
ex.zh: 公司每年都會把頂尖律師與最新進的人員聚在一起進行培訓。

ex.en: Our goal this year is to bring together the most creative group we can find.
ex.zh: 我們今年的目標是集結我們能找到最有創意的團隊。

ex.en: The recruiter will interview all candidates for the position.
ex.zh: 招聘人員將面試所有應徵該職位的候選人。

ex.en: The president of our company is a candidate for the Outstanding Business Award.
ex.zh: 我們公司的總裁是傑出企業獎的候選人。

note: a candidate for sth 某職位或獎項的候選人

ex.en: In order to find good candidates for the position, we need to come up with a good advertising plan.
ex.zh: 為了替這個職位找到好人選,我們需要想出一個好的廣告計畫。

ex.en: How did the new employee come up with that cost-cutting idea after only one week on the job?
ex.zh: 這位新員工才上班一週,怎麼想出那個降低成本的點子的?

note: 三字片語不可分離,受詞一律放最後

ex.en: Generally the first year's salary is commensurate with experience and education level.
ex.zh: 第一年的薪資通常與經驗和教育程度相當。

ex.en: As mentioned in your packets, the number of new recruits will be commensurate with the number of vacancies at the company.
ex.zh: 如資料袋中所述,新進人員的人數將與公司的職缺數相稱。

note: be commensurate with sth,介系詞固定用 with

ex.en: It is difficult to make a decision when both candidates seem to be a perfect match.
ex.zh: 當兩位候選人看起來都完美契合時,很難做決定。

ex.en: A headhunter matches qualified candidates to suitable positions.
ex.zh: 獵才顧問替合格的候選人媒合適當的職位。

note: match A to / with B 把 A 與 B 配對

ex.en: The recruiter told him that, unfortunately, he did not fit the job profile.
ex.zh: 招聘人員告訴他,很遺憾他不符合這個職位的條件輪廓。

ex.en: As jobs change, so does the company's profile for the job candidate.
ex.zh: 隨著工作性質改變,公司對求職者的條件要求也跟著改變。

note: a group of characteristics or traits
fit the profile 符合條件;a high profile 高知名度

ex.en: The job seeker had done volunteer work and was able to add it to his list of qualifications.
ex.zh: 這位求職者做過志工,因此能把它加進自己的資格清單。

ex.en: The applicant had so many qualifications that the company created a new position for her.
ex.zh: 這位應徵者條件太好,公司因此為她新設了一個職位。

note: 表「資格」時多用複數 qualifications
qualify 使合格;qualified 合格的

ex.en: When the consulting firm recruited her, they offered to pay her relocation expenses.
ex.zh: 那家顧問公司招募她時,提出要支付她的搬遷費用。

ex.en: The new recruits spent the entire day in training.
ex.zh: 新進人員整天都在受訓。

note: 動詞唸重音在後,名詞亦然
recruiter 招聘人員;recruitment 招募

ex.en: Submit your résumé to the human resources department.
ex.zh: 請把你的履歷提交給人力資源部門。

ex.en: The applicant submitted all her paperwork in a professional and timely manner.
ex.zh: 這位應徵者以專業且及時的方式提交了所有文件。

ex.en: Even though it was time-consuming, the participants felt that the open house was worthwhile.
ex.zh: 儘管很費時,參加者仍覺得這場說明會很值得。

ex.en: Five interviews later, Ms. Lopez had the job, but it was a time-consuming process.
ex.zh: 經過五次面試後,羅培茲女士得到了這份工作,但過程相當耗時。

note: 必須加連字號;同構詞 labor-consuming
taking up a lot of time、lengthy
